messages:
li: heads up — ran into a weird one in staging. fallback triggered but the audit row was missing for ~20 requests :confused:
maria: uh that sounds bad. which fallback mode? soft or silent?
li: silent-degrade (the one that reroutes to cheaper model with no user-visible error). saw it flip on when a transient 500 hit model-x pool.
jake: can you paste the request id or a snippet of the policy that ran?
li: here's the policy attached to the route:
```json
{
  "route": "/generate",
  "fallback": {
    "mode": "silent-degrade",
    "triggers": ["5xx_rate", "latency_spike"],
    "audit_level": "minimal"
  }
}
```
samir: audit_level=minimal is intentional for perf but it should still emit an event at least once per minute per route. sounds like it skipped.
li: yep. telemetry-bot showed several fallback events in logs but the audit table has a gap.
telemetry-bot: detected fallback events: 2026-01-15T10:02:12Z model-x 5xx_rate (batch: 14)
telemetry-bot: detected fallback events: 2026-01-15T10:02:20Z model-x 5xx_rate (batch: 9)
maria: is anything in the operator inbox? deploy-bot any recent changes to the audit writer?
deploy-bot: deploy: audit-writer v2.1.3 -> v2.2.0 promoted to staging at 2026-01-15T09:58:00Z by jake
jake: i did a minor perf tweak to the audit batching. intended to only reduce small writes. i thought we safeguarded losing rows with an ack.
li: maybe ack path doesn't run for silent-degrade events? code had a fast-path that short-circuits for minimal audits.
samir: that matches a codepath i flagged in review. we defaulted minimal audits to in-memory coalescing and rely on flush on process exit. bad for transient faults.
maria: UX question: should "silent-degrade" be allowed to have audit_level=minimal by default? product wise we want low-noise but we need traceability.
jake: proposal: change default minimal -> at-least-once-event with dedupe TTL. keep payload small but always emit a marker row.
li: i like at-least-once marker. also add operator-facing flag to make silent-degrade write full context if user is on enterprise tier.
samir: and add a console UI item: "fallback health" shows last N markers and a glitch rate. operators should see when audit markers stop.
maria: agree. for rollout UX: show a warning when you opt into silent-degrade + minimal audit that explains risk and suggests the at-least-once marker toggle.
jake: i'll open a PR to change the audit writer and a separate PR for console copy. low-risk rollout: default to marker=true in staging, monitor for spikes.
li: for transparency we should surface a short reason in the audit row: {fallback_mode, trigger, sample_count}. keeps rows tiny but useful.
maria: plus a linkable trace id to the logs so se ok to keep small.
telemetry-bot: alert created: Fallback-Audit-Marker-Missing (rule: missing_marker_count > 3 in 5m)
li: perfect. i'll run a quick simulation in staging to verify marker emission and console visualization.
maria: thanks. follow-up: add a tiny UX modal when editing route fallback that surfaces these tradeoffs. one-liners.
jake: noted. PRs incoming. cc @samir for console wiring.
samir: on it. will add a compact "why this matters" blurb and a sample timeline chart.
li: closing loop — will post results in this thread after sim. thanks all :thumbsup:
